```plato
// Which mesh elements touch which: the six incidence queries between vertices,
// undirected edges, and faces (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Incidence_matrix).
// This is the rung where connectedness lives — a mesh that can answer these can
// be walked, split into components, and classified for manifoldness, with no
// commitment to any stored adjacency structure.
//
// Nothing here promises constant time; a face-vertex list may answer
// FacesOfVertex by scanning. Results are in no guaranteed order unless the
// implementing type documents one, and an empty array is the "none" answer
// (an isolated vertex, a wire edge bordering no face).
interface IMeshIncidence
    inherits IMeshElementCounts
{
    VerticesOfFace(x: Self, face: FaceIndex): Array<VertexIndex>;
    UndirectedEdgesOfFace(x: Self, face: FaceIndex): Array<UndirectedEdgeIndex>;
    FacesOfVertex(x: Self, vertex: VertexIndex): Array<FaceIndex>;
    UndirectedEdgesOfVertex(x: Self, vertex: VertexIndex): Array<UndirectedEdgeIndex>;
    VerticesOfUndirectedEdge(x: Self, edge: UndirectedEdgeIndex): VertexPair;
    FacesOfUndirectedEdge(x: Self, edge: UndirectedEdgeIndex): Array<FaceIndex>;
}
```
